summary: Phase 1 / Week 2 launch: High-intensity Arithmetic Percentages drills and Linear Arrangements, dual job search application batch, and German track 72-hour zero-fee prerequisite audits.

urgent_alerts.title: German Track 72-Hour Zero-Fee Prerequisite Audit
urgent_alerts.action: Complete Anabin H+ check for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat & g.a.s.t., run Passau interactive guide, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Practice (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 LeetCode problems (1 Medium on Two Pointers / Sliding Window + 1 Easy/Review) using DSA Master Tracker.

blocks.title: Monday Job Search Application Batch (8–10 Submissions)
blocks.details: Dedicated Monday morning outreach: submit 8–10 tailored applications on Instahyre and LinkedIn for Full-Stack / SWE roles (Immediate Joiner advantage).

blocks.title: CAT Day 3: Percentages Multipliers & Linear Seating Logic
blocks.details: QA: Percentages Mastery—decimal multipliers, successive changes, and 20 practice drills from Rodha. DILR: 2 timed Linear Seating Arrangement sets from CAT 2022 Slot 1 & 2 on 2IIM.

blocks.title: Germany Prerequisite Audit: Anabin, dMAT & MDU MOI
blocks.details: Execute 72-hour zero-fee checklist: 1. Confirm MDU H+ on anabin.kmk.org. 2. Verify dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat. 3. Run Passau interactive guide. 4. Email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 3: VARC Philosophy RC & Verbal Logic Drills
blocks.details: 3 Reading Comprehension passages (Aeon Philosophy/Sociology) + 8 Verbal Ability questions (Para-jumbles & Odd-One-Out) on Career Launcher MyZone + error log entry.
